firstBuildHook.cause: The new message-carried CallProfile and its nested records had not entered the immutable-record declaration.

namingCollisions: The new generic provenance property conflicted with existing mutable pack-source provenance.
The two new text properties were not unique across immutable State records.
consolidatedDiagnosis.correction: Declare all four new records immutable; name the packet metadata callProvenance, clauseText and demandText. No scanner or check was weakened.
consolidatedDiagnosis.selectorGuard: A dated call retains its registered profile when a selector is omitted and rejects a contradictory selector. Existing reference commands already select the registered profile explicitly.
consolidatedDiagnosis.cheapVerification: 55/55 focused ownership, governor/relay and pack-schema tests; typecheck, rules and seven-day startup replay pass.
consolidatedDiagnosis.retainedEvidence: runs/s102/ownership-diagnosis.log, ownership-correction.log, correction-targeted.log, ownership-consolidated-fix.log, typecheck-corrected.log, rules-corrected.log, smoke-ownership-corrected.log

boundedRevalidation.question: Do the completed immutable packet and selector guards replay and resume with unchanged response/counter behavior, while reporting hashes for the final metadata keys?
boundedRevalidation.scope: Union full reference and Union peace exercise only; reuse all sixteen byte-exact unaffected testbed artifacts.
boundedRevalidation.expectedCost: A few minutes; no seed sweep or calibration campaign.
boundedRevalidation.pass: Replay/resume match, no rejections, all existing bands pass, responses and counters equal the retained pre-correction capture.
boundedRevalidation.stop: Any changed behavior or unexpected failure is diagnosed before another long run.
